responsibility: Defines and documents the complete set of GCC tree codes that make up the language-independent tree IR. Through DEFTREECODE entries it assigns each code its symbolic name, printable spelling, tree-code class, and operand-slot count, with comments describing the semantics and layout expectations of each node kind; these definitions are included to generate enums, name tables, classification tables, and range-optimized predicates used throughout tree.h and the rest of the compiler.
same_name_distinction: Declarative definition list for the tree IR codes, using DEFTREECODE entries to enumerate node kinds, classes, spellings, and arities that other files include to generate tables and predicates. Unlike tree.h and tree.cc, it is not an interface or implementation file for tree-manipulation routines.
